_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "colour_token" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hidden" IN (0, 1)), "monthly_budget" INTEGER NULL, "budget_carries_over" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("budget_carries_over" IN (0, 1)), "budget_warn_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 80, "budget_since" INTEGER NULL, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "colour_token" TEXT NOT NULL, "opening_balance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "balance_at" INTEGER NULL, "ask_fee_each_time" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("ask_fee_each_time" IN (0, 1)), "count_in_totals" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("count_in_totals" IN (0, 1)), "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount" > 0), "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "payee_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "to_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "fee" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("fee" >= 0), "tax" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("tax" >= 0), "note" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "suggested_category_id" TEXT NULL, "suggestion_confidence" REAL NULL, "category_was_corrected" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("category_was_corrected" IN (0, 1)), "flagged_unusual" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("flagged_unusual" IN (0, 1)), "flag_dismissed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("flag_dismissed" IN (0, 1)), "regular_payment_id" TEXT NULL, "foreign_currency" TEXT NULL, "foreign_amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "rate_micros" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "regular_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "payee_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "typical_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_low" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_high" INTEGER NOT NULL, "interval_days" INTEGER NOT NULL, "next_due_on" INTEGER NOT NULL, "times_seen" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "remind" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("remind" IN (0, 1)), "dismissed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dismissed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "forecast_snapshots" ("period_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "taken_on" INTEGER NOT NULL, "point" INTEGER NOT NULL, "low" INTEGER NOT NULL, "high" INTEGER NOT NULL, "spent_so_far" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("period_start", "taken_on"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'wallet', "colour_token" TEXT NOT NULL, "target" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("target" > 0), "target_day" INTEGER NULL, "remind_every" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'off', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "reached_at" INTEGER NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal_moves" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "goal_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES goals (id), "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(NOT ("amount" = 0)), "note" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
